rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите! Вот он! Росток!
rows.text: Look! There it is! A sprout!
rows.heard: Look, there it is, a sprout.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Доброе утро, малыш. Это я, твой сторож.
rows.text: Good morning, little one. It's me, your guard.
rows.heard: Good morning, little one. It's me, your guard.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Он вылез прямо из жёлудя!
rows.text: It came right out of the acorn!
rows.heard: it came right out of the acorn.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Вот корешок. Белый, тоненький. Он ушёл в землю.
rows.text: Here's the root. White and thin. It went into the ground.
rows.heard: Here's the root, white and thin, it went into the ground.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А стебелёк смотрит вверх. К солнцу.
rows.text: And the stem looks up. To the sun.
rows.heard: and the stem looks up to the sun.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А как он узнал, где верх? Он же только проснулся!
rows.text: How did it know where up is? It just woke up!
rows.heard: How did it know where up is? It just woke up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Может, ему кто-то подсказал? Шёпотом.
rows.text: Maybe someone told it? In a whisper.
rows.heard: Maybe someone told it in a whisper.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Жёлудь на боку. А корешок всё равно повернул вниз.
rows.text: The acorn is on its side. But the root still turned down.
rows.heard: The acorn is on its side, but the root still turned down.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Корешок чувствует, где низ. Земля тянет всё вниз — и яблоко, и камешек, и нас.
rows.text: The root feels where down is. The Earth pulls everything down: apples, pebbles, and us.
rows.heard: The root feels where down is. The earth pulls everything down. Apples, pebbles, and us.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: И меня?
rows.text: Me too?
rows.heard: Me too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Правда! Я снова внизу.
rows.text: True! I'm down again.
rows.heard: True, I'm down again.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Вот и корешок это чувствует. Поэтому он всегда растёт вниз, в землю. Там вода.
rows.text: The root feels it too. So it always grows down, where the water is.
rows.heard: The root feels it too, so it always grows down where the water is.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: А стебелёк ищет свет. Поэтому он растёт вверх.
rows.text: And the stem looks for light. So it grows up.
rows.heard: And the stem looks for light, so it grows up.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Корешок — вниз, стебелёк — вверх. А я?
rows.text: The root goes down, the stem goes up. And me?
rows.heard: The root goes down, the stem goes up, and me.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я — во все стороны!
rows.text: And I go every way!
rows.heard: And I go every way.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Корешок — вниз, к воде. Стебелёк — вверх, к солнцу
rows.text: The root goes down, to the water. The stem goes up, to the sun.
rows.heard: The root goes down to the water, the stem goes up to the sun.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Росток, наверное, проголодался. Отнесу ему печенье!
rows.text: The sprout must be hungry. I'll bring it a cookie!
rows.heard: The sprout must be hungry. I'll bring it a cookie.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Рон, ростки не едят печенье.
rows.text: Ron, sprouts don't eat cookies.
rows.heard: Run! Sprouts don't eat cookies!

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Совсем? Даже с изюмом?
rows.text: Never? Not even with raisins?
rows.heard: Never, not even with raisins.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: У ростка свой обед. Он внутри жёлудя.
rows.text: The sprout has its own lunch. Inside the acorn.
rows.heard: The sprout has its own lunch inside the acorn.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: В жёлуде? Там же пусто!
rows.text: In the acorn? But it's empty!
rows.heard: in the acorn, but it's empty.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Не пусто. В жёлуде спрятан запас еды. Росток ест его, пока у него мало листиков.
rows.text: It's not empty. It has a food stash inside. The sprout eats it while it has few leaves.
rows.heard: It's not empty, it has a food stash inside. The sprout eats it while it has few leaves.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Как обед в дорогу!
rows.text: Like a packed lunch!
rows.heard: Like a packed lunch.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Точно. Жёлудь для ростка — как обед в дорогу.
rows.text: Right. The acorn is the sprout's packed lunch.
rows.heard: Right, the acorn is the sprouts packed lunch.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Значит, печенье опять моё.
rows.text: So the cookie is mine again.
rows.heard: So the cookie is mine again.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Очень вкусный запас.
rows.text: A yummy stash.
rows.heard: A yummy stash.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Рон, у тебя крошки на носу.
rows.text: Ron, you have crumbs on your nose.
rows.heard: Ron, you have crumbs on your nose.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Это тоже запас. На потом.
rows.text: That's a stash too. For later.
rows.heard: That's a stash two, for later.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот наш росток. Наверное, хочет пить. Я его полью!
rows.text: Look, here's our sprout. It must be thirsty. I'll water it!
rows.heard: Look, here's our sprout. It must be thirsty. I'll water it.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пей, малыш! Ещё! И ещё!
rows.text: Drink up, little one! More! And more!
rows.heard: Drink up little one, more and more.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Стой, Рон! Хватит!
rows.text: Stop, Ron! Enough!
rows.heard: Stop rolling, enough.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Ой! Смотрите, вот лужа!
rows.text: Oh! Look, a puddle!
rows.heard: Oh, like a puddle.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я немножко перестарался.
rows.text: I overdid it a little.
rows.heard: I overdid it a little.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Корешку нужна вода. Но и воздух тоже. Если залить землю, ему нечем дышать.
rows.text: The root needs water. But it needs air too. Too much water, and it can't breathe.
rows.heard: The root needs water, but it needs air too. Too much water and it can't breathe.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Помните нашу лужу? Солнце её выпьет.
rows.text: Remember our puddle? The sun will drink it up.
rows.heard: Remember our puddle, the sun will drink it up.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А ветер поможет!
rows.text: The wind will help!
rows.heard: The wind will help.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я буду поливать понемножку. Одну чашечку в день.
rows.text: Then I'll water just a little. One small cup a day.
rows.heard: Then I'll water just a little, one small cup a day.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вот это правильно.
rows.text: That's right.
rows.heard: That's right.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот цветок на окне.
rows.text: Look, a flower by the window.
rows.heard: Look a flower by the window.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Он повернул листики к окну!
rows.text: It turned its leaves to the window!
rows.heard: It turned its leaves to the window.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Растения любят свет. Листики ловят солнце, как ладошки.
rows.text: Plants love light. Leaves catch the sun, like little hands.
rows.heard: Plants love light. Leaves catch the sun like little hands.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: А зачем им солнце?
rows.text: Why do they need sun?
rows.heard: Why do they need sun?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Чтобы готовить себе сладкий сок. Для этого нужны вода, воздух и солнечный свет.
rows.text: To make their own sweet juice. For that they need water, air and sunlight.
rows.heard: to make their own sweet juice. For that they need water, air and sunlight.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Из солнца можно сделать что-то вкусное? А печенье можно?
rows.text: You can make yummy things from the sun? What about cookies?
rows.heard: You can make yummy things from the sun. What about cookies?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Печенье — нет. А сладкий сок для листика — да.
rows.text: Cookies, no. But sweet juice for the leaf, yes.
rows.heard: Cookies know, but sweet juice for the leaf, yes.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Значит, когда обед в жёлуде кончится, росток будет кушать солнце!
rows.text: So when the lunch in the acorn runs out, the sprout will eat sunshine!
rows.heard: So when the lunch in the acorn runs out, the sprout will eat sunshine.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Правильно. Поэтому ему так нужны листики.
rows.text: Right. That's why it needs leaves.
rows.heard: Right, that's why it needs leaves.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я тоже постою на солнышке. Вдруг наемся.
rows.text: Then I'll stand in the sun too. Maybe I'll get full.
rows.heard: Then I'll stand in the sun too, maybe I'll get full.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Нет. Всё равно хочу печенье.
rows.text: Nope. I still want a cookie.
rows.heard: Nope, I still want a cookie.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот наш росток. Вдруг кто-нибудь на него наступит? Он же маленький.
rows.text: Look, here's our sprout. What if someone steps on it? It's so small.
rows.heard: Look, here's our sprout. What if someone steps on it? It's so small.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Поставим заборчик.
rows.text: Let's build a fence.
rows.heard: Let's build a fence.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я нарисую табличку!
rows.text: I'll draw a sign!
rows.heard: I'll draw a sign.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тихо! Тут растёт дуб!
rows.text: Shh! An oak grows here!
rows.heard: SHH, an oak grows here.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Но это же ещё не дуб.
rows.text: But it's not an oak yet.
rows.heard: But it's not an oak yet.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Пусть привыкает. Будет большим.
rows.text: Let it get used to it. It'll be big.
rows.heard: Let it get used to it, it'll be big.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Хороший заборчик. Теперь никто не наступит.
rows.text: Nice fence. Now no one will step on it.
rows.heard: Nice fence, now no one will step on it.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Смотрите, вот большой дуб!
rows.text: Look, a big oak!
rows.heard: Look a big oak.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Неужели наш малыш станет таким же?
rows.text: Will our little one really get this big?
rows.heard: Well, our little one really get this big.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Станет. Только не скоро. Дубы растут очень медленно.
rows.text: Yes. But not soon. Oaks grow very slowly.
rows.heard: Yes, but not soon. Oaks grow very slowly.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Этому дубу, наверное, больше ста лет.
rows.text: This oak must be over a hundred years old.
rows.heard: This oak must be over 100 years old.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Ста лет? Я столько не высижу. Даже с печеньем.
rows.text: A hundred years? I can't wait that long. Not even with cookies.
rows.heard: A hundred years, I can't wait that long, not even with cookies.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Какой высокий! У меня голова закружилась.
rows.text: So tall! It makes me dizzy.
rows.heard: So tall, it makes me dizzy.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Когда-то этот великан тоже был совсем крошечным.
rows.text: Once, this giant was tiny too.
rows.heard: Once this giant was tiny too.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И тоже вылез из жёлудя?
rows.text: From an acorn too?
rows.heard: from an acorn too.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Да. Из одного маленького жёлудя.
rows.text: Yes. From one little acorn.
rows.heard: Yes, from one little acorn.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Значит, и наш малыш будет великаном!
rows.text: So our little one will be a giant too!
rows.heard: So our little one will be a giant two.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: А я — сторож великана. Звучит!
rows.text: And I'm the giant's guard. Sounds great!
rows.heard: And I'm the Giant's Guard, sounds great!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Давайте поиграем! Я спрашиваю, а вы отвечаете.
rows.text: Let's play a game! I ask, and you answer.
rows.heard: Let's play a game. I ask and you answer.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Начинай!
rows.text: Go ahead!
rows.heard: Go ahead.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Куда растёт корешок?
rows.text: Where does the root grow?
rows.heard: Where does the root grow?

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Вниз! В землю!
rows.text: Down! Into the ground!
rows.heard: down into the ground.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Правильно! А что ест росток, пока он маленький?
rows.text: Right! And what does the sprout eat while it's small?
rows.heard: Write, and what does the sprout eat while it's small?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Запас еды в жёлуде.
rows.text: Food in the acorn.
rows.heard: Food in the acorn!

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: А что нужно ростку, чтобы расти дальше?
rows.text: And what does the sprout need to keep growing?
rows.heard: And what does the sprout need to keep growing?

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Вода, свет и тёплая земля.
rows.text: Water, light and warm soil.
rows.heard: water, light, and warm soil.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: И сторож!
rows.text: And a guard!
rows.heard: and a guard.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: И сторож. Все ответили!
rows.text: And a guard. Everyone answered!
rows.heard: And a guard, everyone answered.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Вот наш росток. Я буду сторожить его всю ночь.
rows.text: Here's our sprout. I'll guard it all night.
rows.heard: Here's our sprout. I'll guard it all night.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Всю ночь? Ты же уснёшь.
rows.text: All night? You'll fall asleep.
rows.heard: All night you'll fall asleep.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я? Никогда. Я самый бодрый сторож.
rows.text: Me? Never. I'm the most awake guard ever.
rows.heard: Me? Never. I'm the most awake guard ever.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Росток, а ты ночью растёшь?
rows.text: Sprout, do you grow at night?
rows.heard: Sprout, do you grow at night?

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Растёт. Только медленно. Он тоже отдыхает.
rows.text: It does. But slowly. It rests too.
rows.heard: It does, but slowly, it rests too.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Тогда я тоже немножко отдохну. Одним глазом.
rows.text: Then I'll rest a little too. With one eye.
rows.heard: Then I'll rest a little too with one eye.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Самый бодрый сторож уснул.
rows.text: The most awake guard fell asleep.
rows.heard: The most awake guard fell asleep.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Пусть спят оба. Утром посмотрим.
rows.text: Let them both sleep. We'll look in the morning.
rows.heard: Let them both sleep. We'll look in the morning.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Я не спал! Я сторожил с закрытыми глазами!
rows.text: I wasn't sleeping! I was guarding with my eyes closed!
rows.heard: I wasn't sleeping. I was guarding with my eyes closed.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Вот росток! На месте! Целый и невредимый!
rows.text: There's the sprout! Still there! Safe and sound!
rows.heard: There's the sprout, still there, safe and sound.

rows.name: Филя
rows.ru: Ночью росток спал. И Рон тоже
rows.text: The sprout slept at night. And so did Ron.
rows.heard: The sprout slept at night, and so did Ron.

rows.name: Топа
rows.ru: Ой! Шишка закрылась!
rows.text: Oh! The pine cone closed!
rows.heard: Oh, the pine cone closed.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Значит, воздух сырой. Стало холодно. Может пойти снег.
rows.text: So the air is damp. It got cold. It might snow.
rows.heard: So the air is damp, it got cold, it might snow.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Снег? А как же наш росток? Он же замёрзнет!
rows.text: Snow? What about our sprout? It'll freeze!
rows.heard: Snow, what about our sprout? It'll freeze.

rows.name: Барсик
rows.ru: Не знаю, Рон. Это новая загадка.
rows.text: I don't know, Ron. That's a new mystery.
rows.heard: I don't know, Ron. That's a new mystery.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Надо срочно связать ему шарф!
rows.text: I must knit it a scarf, quick!
rows.heard: I must knit it a scarf quick.

rows.name: Пик
rows.ru: Завтра узнаем, как дубы прячутся от зимы.
rows.text: Tomorrow we'll learn how oaks hide from winter.
rows.heard: Tomorrow we'll learn how oaks hide from winter.

rows.name: Рон
rows.ru: Понравился мультик? Попроси маму или папу подписаться на канал. До встречи в новой серии!
rows.text: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode!
rows.heard: Did you like the cartoon? Ask mom or dad to subscribe to the channel. See you in the next episode.
